Hacking-Leiter (leicht): Die (erfundene): Hacking ladder (easy): The (made-up) security company Kristall Security only hires people who crack its application CTF. Ten rounds on its careers page.
Webseiten wie ein Pentester lesen: Quell: Read websites like a pentester: source code, hidden paths, headers, cookies, scripts, backups, config leaks.
Nur das Sandbox-Terminal in diesem Raum: Only the sandbox terminal in this room (~/bewerbung). SIMULATION – made-up systems, no real network traffic.
None needed – the sandbox is isolated.
Nichts nötig. Dein Fortschritt bleibt ge: Nothing needed. Your progress stays saved.
Die Bewerbung · Sandbox bereit. Start: c: Die Bewerbung · Sandbox ready. Start: cat LIESMICH.txt · help shows commands.
Kommentare, robots.txt, Header, Cookies,: Comments, robots.txt, headers, cookies, JavaScript, .bak, .env, checksums, metadata, sitemap.
Die meisten Funde im echten Pentest sind: Most findings in a real pentest are exactly these kinds of small things.
Simulation. Im Juice Shop findest du das: Simulation. In Juice Shop you can find the same things for real.
Die Startseite sieht harmlos aus. Aber w: The home page looks harmless. But what is in the source code?
Im Browser siehst du nur die fertige Sei: In the browser you only see the finished page. The source code also shows what is not displayed.
curl ADRESSE zeigt den Quelltext einer W: curl ADDRESS shows the source code of a web page. Comments are between <!-- and -->.
Der Kommentar verriet: Schau in robots.t: The comment gave it away: look in robots.txt.
robots.txt ist ein Zettel für Suchmaschi: robots.txt is a note for search engines: it says which pages they should NOT look at – so often exactly the interesting ones. It is always right under the address: /robots.txt
Disallow heißt „nicht erlaubt“. Den Pfad: Disallow means "not allowed". Add the path after it to the address and fetch it with curl.
Die Seite /start schickt mehr als nur HT: The page /start sends more than just HTML.
Ein Webserver schickt vor der eigentlich: Before the actual page, a web server sends invisible lines at the top, the headers – like an envelope around a letter. How could you look at just the envelope?
curl -I zeigt nur die Header. Selbst erf: curl -I shows only the headers. Self-made headers often start with X-.
Was die Webseite verrät: Was die Webseite verrät (what the website gives away)
Die Anmeldeseite /login setzt ein Cookie: The login page /login sets a cookie.
Ein Cookie ist ein kleiner Datenzettel,: A cookie is a small note of data that the website gives your browser. It comes in a header called Set-Cookie – you can see it with curl -I, like in round 2.
Der Wert hinter profil= (bis zum ;) ist: The value after profil= (up to the ;) is Base64.
Ausschneiden in zwei Schritten: cut -d=: Cut it out in two steps: cut -d= -f2 takes the piece after the first =, then cut -d';' -f1 takes the piece before the ;.
Lösung: curl -I http://karriere.kristall: Solution: curl -I http://karriere.kristall.sim/login | grep Set-Cookie | cut -d= -f2 | cut -d';' -f1 | base64 -d
Die Seite /bewerben lädt eine JavaScript: The page /bewerben loads a JavaScript file. Developers often forget things in there.
curl …/bewerben zeigt, welche Datei gela: curl …/bewerben shows which file gets loaded.
In form.js steht ein Wert aus lauter 0–9: In form.js there is a value made only of 0–9 and a–f: hex. Each character is written as two hex digits (4b = K).
Der Wert steht zwischen zwei Anführungsz: The value is between two quotation marks. cut -d'"' -f2 splits at the " and takes the piece in between.
xxd -r -p wandelt reines Hex zurück in T: xxd -r -p turns plain hex back into text.
Lösung: curl http://karriere.kristall.si: Solution: curl http://karriere.kristall.sim/js/form.js | grep testCode | cut -d'"' -f2 | xxd -r -p
Editoren und Admins hinterlassen gern Si: Editors and admins often leave backup copies with the extension .bak.
Internally, the home page is called index.html.
Viele Webanwendungen speichern Geheimnis: Many web apps store secrets in a file called .env. It never belongs on the web.
Dateien mit Punkt am Anfang sind auch im: Files starting with a dot are "hidden" on the web too – but only if the server really blocks them.
Die Datei liegt direkt unter der Adresse: The file is right under the address: /.env
In wort.sha256 steht die Prüfsumme eines: wort.sha256 contains the checksum of a word from woerter.txt. That word is a path on the website.
echo -n WORT | sha256sum berechnet die P: echo -n WORD | sha256sum calculates the checksum of a word (-n: without a line break).
Eine Prüfsumme ist wie ein Fingerabdruck: A checksum is like a fingerprint: the same word always gives the same checksum, but you can’t calculate backwards. You can, however, calculate the checksum for EVERY word in woerter.txt and compare.
Für jedes Wort die Prüfsumme UND das Wor: For each word, write the checksum AND the word on one line: for w in $(cat woerter.txt); do echo "$(echo -n $w | sha256sum) $w"; done
Mit grep $(cat wort.sha256) findest du d: With grep $(cat wort.sha256) you find the matching line.
Lösung: for w in $(cat woerter.txt); do: Solution: for w in $(cat woerter.txt); do echo "$(echo -n $w | sha256sum) $w"; done | grep $(cat wort.sha256) → curl http://karriere.kristall.sim/raum/WORD
Im Foto eines früheren Bewerbers stecken: The photo of a former applicant contains metadata (a comment).
Bilder enthalten neben den Pixeln oft le: Besides the pixels, images often contain readable extra info.
strings zeigt lesbaren Text, grep -i com: strings shows readable text, grep -i comment filters it.
Die Sitemap listet 25 Seiten. Nur eine d: The sitemap lists 25 pages. Only one of them still exists – the last task.
Eine Sitemap ist ein Inhaltsverzeichnis: A sitemap is a table of contents of the website for search engines. curl http://karriere.kristall.sim/sitemap.xml shows all addresses.
grep -o \"/seite-[^<]*\" schneidet nur d: grep -o "/seite-[^<]*" cuts out just the paths (-o = only the match, [^<]* = all characters up to the next <).
Ob eine Seite existiert, zeigt die erste: The first header line shows whether a page exists: curl -s -I ADDRESS | head -1 reports 200 (exists) or 404 (does not exist).
Pack beides in eine Schleife: for p in $: Put both into a loop: for p in $(…); do echo "$p $(curl -s -I …$p | head -1)"; done – and filter at the end with grep 200.
Lösung: for p in $(curl -s http://karrie: Solution: for p in $(curl -s http://karriere.kristall.sim/sitemap.xml | grep -o "/seite-[^<]*"); do echo "$p $(curl -s -I http://karriere.kristall.sim$p | head -1)"; done | grep 200 → curl that path
